final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS zoneref, t.typesite AS typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_press, AVG(CAST(s.gbsize AS REAL) / s.spanmin) AS avg_ratio FROM scans s JOIN sites t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_press) AS result_press, AVG(avg_ratio) AS result_ratio FROM step1
